title: CERT-In Advisory   CIAD-2026-0040
content:
CERT-In Advisory  
                                                                      CIAD-2026-0040
Multiple Vulnerabilities in SAP Products
Original Issue Date: August    18, 2026
Severity Rating: Critical
Software Affected
SAP Commerce Cloud (Data Hub Adapter)
SAP Manufacturing Integration and Intelligence (MII)
SAP NetWeaver and ABAP Platform
SAP ABAP Developer Tools
SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence Platform
SAP Commerce Cloud
SAP Business AI Platform (Approuter)
SAPUI5
SAP Social Intelligence
SAP NetWeaver AS Java / Adobe Document Services
SAPSPrint Service
SAP FICA ODN Framework
SAP S/4HANA
SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization (Model Mix Planning)
SAP Data Services Management Console
SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence Platform (Admin Tools)
Overview
Multiple vulnerabilities have been reported in SAP products, which could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code, escalate privileges, bypass authorization controls, access sensitive information, and compromise the integrity and availability of affected systems.
Target Audience:
All end-user organizations and individuals using the SAP Products.
Risk Assessment:
High risk of privilege escalation, spoofing, sensitive information disclosure.
Impact Assessment:
High impact on Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability of the affected systems.
Description
Multiple vulnerabilities have been reported in SAP products, details of which are provided below:
